claims.claim_text: The imitation losses cause the model to imitate the expert’s demonstrations, while the environment losses discourage undesirable behavior such as collisions.
claims.normalized_text: Imitation losses cause model to imitate expert demonstrations; environment losses discourage undesirable behavior like collisions.

claims.claim_text: We experimented with randomly dropping out the imitation losses for a random subset of training examples, referred to as "imitation dropout".
claims.normalized_text: Imitation dropout is randomly dropping out imitation losses for a subset of training examples.

claims.claim_text: Imitation dropout yields a better driving model than simply under-weighting the imitation losses.
claims.normalized_text: Imitation dropout yields better driving model than under-weighting imitation losses.
